hazards.control: Radio silence and RF-safe systems per the site plan; licensed personnel.

name: Pressure setting assembly body
function: The cylinder above the adapter kit where the power charge burns and the piston converts gas pressure into the setting stroke.

tabs.overview: Charge size and piston area set the force; bleed ports vent after the set.
tabs.engineering: Steel body rated for the charge pressure.
tabs.safety: Explosive item; misfire procedures per the explosives rules.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
